rationale: LPP news hub is a live, standalone feed on Urbana open-loop/contactless acceptance — a leading indicator for payments rollout.
JHL press room issues the archivable PDF releases behind LPP/Urbana payment announcements; standalone publisher.
National rail ticketing/terms pages document accepted instruments incl. Flik — dated evidence of A2A acceptance beyond retail.
National IJPP smartcard scheme portal is in-scope and standalone, but fetch failed — re-check liveness before approving.
Merchant terms of business publicly name the PSP/acquirer (Mangopay, GoCrypto, Flik) — rare acceptance-side disclosure, updated over time.
Lidl SI newsroom/app pages are the primary record of Lidl Pay and any Wero/A2A arrival in Slovenian grocery acceptance.
Major grocery chain communications on self-checkout and cash/card mix are in scope, but URL verification failed — re-verify.
Parking app operator pages document accepted instruments and town-by-town coin-to-app migration; recurring acceptance signals.
Single dated municipal notice about EasyPark — useful evidence; the municipal news hub/aggregator would be the monitorable parent.
Maribor transport/parking operator notices cover the under-reported non-Ljubljana municipal acceptance layer.
Consumer-tech blog is often first to cover Slovenian merchant payment launches with operational detail; useful early-warning layer.
Long-running IT trade press with technical depth on wallet/POS launches and a deep archive for timeline reconstruction.
National-news tag feeds carry retailer quotes on cash-vs-card and cash-acceptance legislation; tag page works as a topic feed.
Retail chamber is the collective merchant voice on interchange/merchant fees and cash obligations, plus a member actor map.
AJPES is the statutory register/filings sink — the only systematic financials route for unlisted merchants and PSPs; standalone and durable.
Central bank payments-market analysis provides the authoritative denominator for acceptance and cash-access metrics; legally clear.
Third grocery chain's loyalty-app pages complete grocery acceptance coverage; standalone but lower signal density.
Static bsi.si complaint-channel page defining the legal taxonomy; covered by monitoring the Banka Slovenije parent.
Annual-report series is a distinct, recurring publication stream carrying complaint volumes and supervisory actions.
ZBS ADR body publishes bank dispute volumes, subject matter and outcomes — a direct, recurring read on bank consumer failures.
Main consumer association publishes named-bank fee comparisons and payment-abuse casework; continuous in-scope output.
Static directory of Slovenian supervisory bodies — mine once for the actor map, then archive; dated 2019.
Searchable DPA opinions include many bank-specific data-processing cases; a continuously produced, high-credibility stream.
Static mandate/powers page on ip-rs.si; context only, covered by monitoring the DPA opinions parent.
FOI catalogue is the documented one-off route to request unpublished inspection decisions naming banks/PSPs, not a signal feed.
Machine-readable OPSI dataset of DPA case practice — most collectible form for automated bank/payment keyword filtering.
Official case-law database with rulings on unauthorised payment transactions and bank liability; litigation signals unavailable elsewhere.
Judiciary portal serves mainly as a pointer to per-court databases already covered by sodnapraksa.si.
